name: Diyaluma Falls
description: The second-highest waterfall in Sri Lanka, famous for its multiple upper natural pools where visitors can swim right on the edge of the roaring drop.

name: Bambarakanda Falls
description: Standing at a majestic 263 meters, this is the tallest waterfall in Sri Lanka, cascading down a sheer vertical cliff surrounded by serene pine forests.

name: Ravana Falls
description: A highly popular and easily accessible multi-tier waterfall in Ella, linked to the epic Ramayana legend and offering dramatic flow during the rainy season.

name: Dunhinda Falls
description: Known as the 'Bridal Fall' for its smoky water spray, this 63-meter cascade is reached via a scenic jungle trek near Badulla town.

name: Devon Falls
description: Nicknamed the 'Veil of the Valley', this 97-meter multi-tiered waterfall cascades gracefully opposite lush tea plantations along the Hatton-Nuwara Eliya road.

name: St. Clair's Falls
description: Widely known as the 'Little Niagara of Sri Lanka', this wide, powerful double-waterfall flows past rolling tea fields near Kotagala.

name: Baker's Falls
description: A famous 20-meter wide cascade situated on the main walking loop inside Horton Plains National Park, surrounded by cloud forest rhododendrons.

name: Laxapana Falls
description: The 8th highest waterfall in Sri Lanka at 126 meters, plunging over a dramatic rock cliff into a deep green natural gorge.

name: Aberdeen Falls
description: A picturesque 98-meter waterfall located in Ginigathena featuring a deep, dark blue plunge pool framed by towering rock walls.

name: Ramboda Falls
description: A massive 109-meter high triple-tiered waterfall visible directly from the A5 highway, featuring a scenic hotel viewpoint and river walk.

name: Lover's Leap Waterfall
description: A romantic and historical 30-meter waterfall originating from Pidurutalagala peak, accessible via a short hike past Pedro Tea Estate.

name: Bomburu Ella
description: Sri Lanka's widest waterfall complex, consisting of several parallel cascades flowing down a massive jungle rock face near Perawella.

name: Bopath Ella
description: A unique waterfall shaped like a sacred Bo (Pipul) leaf, located near Kuruwita and popular for local river excursions.

name: Kirindi Ella
description: A 116-meter cascade near Pelmadulla that falls into a deep natural pool known as 'Diyagathwala', surrounded by dense lush vegetation.

name: Surathali Ella
description: A delicate 60-meter slip-style waterfall located right beside the Colombo-Badulla main road in Belihuloya.

name: Olu Ella
description: A multi-step waterfall in Yatiyanthota that resembles a white lotus flower blooming over high rock ledges.

name: Asupini Ella
description: A powerful 30-meter waterfall on the Maha Oya river near Aranayaka, linked to ancient folk legends of royal courtly horses.

name: Sera Ella
description: A wide waterfall in the Dumbara valley featuring a unique cave behind the curtain of falling water that hikers can walk through.

name: Hunas Falls
description: A picturesque 50-meter waterfall located within the grounds of Hunas Falls Hotel in Elkaduwa, feeding a scenic lake.

name: Huluganga Falls
description: A 75-meter high waterfall originating from the Knuckles range, cascading down past Huluganga village bridge.
